text: 【未来材料提交IPO辅导备案】2026年8月1日，证监会官网IPO辅导公示系统显示，山东东岳未来氢能材料股份有限公司（简称“未来材料”）向山东证监局提交辅导备案，辅导券商为中信建投。
text_en: [Future Materials files for IPO tutoring filing] On August 1, 2026, the CSRC's IPO tutoring disclosure system showed that Shandong Dongyue Future Hydrogen Energy Materials Co., Ltd. ("Future Materials") submitted a tutoring filing to the Shandong Securities Regulatory Bureau, with CITIC Securities as the tutoring sponsor.
